shared_elements: low-relief figure shown in strict profile
human-form figure with detailed patterned garment and long hair/beard
arm extended forward holding an object
stylized floral/vegetal ornament (rosettes vs palmette foliage)
figures set on a flat field within a framed panel/register
justification: Both show large flat-relief figures in strict profile with carefully patterned hair/beard and garment, an outstretched arm grasping an object, and stylized floral ornament as a subsidiary motif, which suggests broadly comparable relief conventions. But the depicted subjects differ entirely: A is a narrative scene of a charioteer with harnessed horse and spoked wheel above a rosette band, while B is a bird-headed winged attendant with bucket beside a stylized foliate tree.
